mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_message (id, session_id, role, content, ai_skill, sentiment_label, input_tokens, output_tokens, guidance_action, guidance_target, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{aiSkill}, #{sentimentLabel}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{guidanceAction}, #{guidanceTarget}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT m.* FROM ai_chat_message m INNER JOIN ai_chat_session s ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE s.session_uuid = #{sessionUuid} ORDER BY m.created_at ASC
